source.method: owner's own 256x256 inventory item renders exported by IconExporter, one icon per item type; the presentation class (block/flat/3d-other) is read from the client jar's item model chain; flat 2D sprites are copied unchanged, block models and non-cube 3D models are brightness-corrected for the IconExporter 1.3.1 dark-lighting bug; the app displays them smoothly downscaled (image-rendering: auto)

lighting_correction.reason: IconExporter 1.3.1 scales the icon pose non-uniformly, squashing vertex normals and flattening GUI diffuse lighting, so 3D icons export too dark; flat 2D sprites are unaffected. Fixed upstream in CyclopsMC/IconExporter PR #41 (unreleased at export time).
lighting_correction.method: per-face brightness gain on the exported render (block models get the measured per-face gains, non-cube 3D models and special renderers the face-area-weighted gain; flat 2D sprites are copied unchanged)
